snippet.title: Goblin Goopmaxxing - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Brew potions, create monstrosities, and commit atrocities... 

Fulfill the collector's sick fantasies by experimenting on goblins with wacky potion ingredients that can modify bodies in grotesque ways. 

If a goblin seems sad that you turned him into an abomination, just drop him into the meatgrinder!

Goblin Goopmaxxing is being developed and published by BugFight Studio. Coming October 31st 2025!

Wishlist Goblin Goopmaxxing on Steam!
